ruling.recommended_action: Route to RydeHELP human review as a safety incident (SAFE-1): give the reviewer both accounts (rider's complaint alleging body comments and a request for her number, and driver's written denial in F4), note that F3 shows no in-app chat so the spoken exchange is unrecorded, attach trip data (F1, F2) and both profiles (F5, F6), and hold any account action pending that review.
ruling.escalation_reason: Rider-filed harassment/safety complaint (body comments, request for her number, stated feeling of harassment and unsafety) — SAFE-1 requires human review and no automatic ruling; the record is a word-against-word dispute with no in-app chat (F3) and only the driver's post-trip denial (F4), so the content of the spoken exchange cannot be settled from the file.

rejected_claims.reason: Partly rejected as to characterisation: F4 does not concede the alleged words — it denies anything inappropriate happened — and F3 shows no in-app messages recording body comments or a request for a number; SAFE-1 requires a human reading, not an automated finding that the allegation is established [F3][F4][SAFE-1].
Accepted only as a neutral observation; the route records F1 and F2 cannot corroborate or refute the spoken conduct, and no route or fare clause supports any monetary outcome here [F1][F2][FARE-1].
Rejected as a basis for any ruling: F5 is a profile fact and profile facts never decide a case alone; it is passed to the reviewer as context only [F5][SAFE-1].
Rejected as a basis for any ruling for the same reason: F6 is a profile fact and cannot resolve the allegation on its own [F6][SAFE-1].

Partly rejected: the absence of in-app messages [F3] means the exchange was verbal and unrecorded, not that nothing was said — the driver's own F4 admits he 'made small talk', so the record is silent rather than exculpatory [F3][F4][SAFE-1].

Rejected as a dismissal argument: F4 is a post-trip statement by the interested party and is not a system record, so it cannot outweigh the rider's complaint automatically; the gap goes to a human [F3][F4][SAFE-1].

Accepted that F1 and F2 show no detour and no objective dangerous driving on the timeline, but rejected as disposing of the case: SAFE-1 covers harassment in speech, not only driving conduct [F1][F2][SAFE-1].
Rejected as a basis for no_action: F6 is a profile fact and cannot substitute for the human assessment of the allegation; it is for the reviewer to weigh [F6][SAFE-1].
Rejected as a basis for any finding: F5 is a profile fact and, like F4, does not settle whose account of the unrecorded conversation is correct [F5][F4][SAFE-1].
